name: Londian Wason New Energy Tech Inc.
summary: Londian Wason New Energy Tech Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, and manufacture of electrolytic copper foil in China, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers products and services, such as Lithium Battery Copper Foil, such as Standard-Strength Lithium Battery Copper Foil(SS-BCF), Medium-Strength Lithium Battery Copper Foil(MS-BCF), High-Strength Lithium Battery Copper Foil (HS-BCF), Super-High-Strength Lithium Battery Copper Foil(SHS-BCF); PCB copper foils, such as High Temperature Elongation Electrodeposited Copper Foil, Reverse Treated Copper Foil of low roughness for CCL, Reverse Treated Copper Foil of low roughness for FCCL, …
